guide.title: User Guide
guide.step1_desc: Click the upload button or drag-and-drop images onto the page. Supports JPG/PNG/WebP. You can also use the camera on mobile.
guide.step2_desc: Three scan modes available at the top: B&W Scan, Color Clear, and Shadow Removal. Choose the best one for your needs.
guide.step3_desc: Click the download button after processing. The image will be saved to your device automatically.
guide.tip1: Try to fill the frame with the document and use even lighting for best results
guide.tip2: If auto-detection isn't accurate, use "Manual Adjust" to drag the four corner points
guide.tip3: Supports processing up to 3 images at once
guide.manual_desc: Click "Manual Adjust" to open the corner editor. You can drag the four blue markers to precisely adjust the crop area. Pinch to zoom for details.
